status: Agreed mechanics and Level Design contract for Prototype 98; runtime integration and playtesting pending
scope: Short Level 2 flush only. No full log ride, new monster roster, Level 3, or additional weapon system.
authority_note: Engineering relayed Sean approval through PM on October24; activates this short flush only and supersedes the older proposal hold for this scope.

coordinates.hero_render_anchor: Feet at projected world position; existing selected-hero art, no sprite shrink workaround
coordinates.jump_clearance: Upper playable foot176.8 minus46px hero body minus33.64px projected peak remains97.16px, clear of HUD64.

timeline.clock: 45 seconds of simulation; pause/death/blocking dialogue freeze it. No wall-clock progression. A harmless landing conversation can extend presentation after45.

stages.name: calm arrival
stages.controls: Steer, jump and fire; gentle current. Three short radio lines and center-to-bottom gag may run here.

stages.name: warned debris survival
stages.controls: Steer, jump and fire normally; no kill quota.

stages.name: automatic drain
stages.controls: Clear every hazard/warning/projectile, then controlled inward spiral; disable damaging collisions. No obstruction/kill gate.

stages.name: safe landing
stages.controls: Finish on the authored static landing/log prop. No ride gameplay starts.

timeline.overlay_guard: Never start damaging stage while center gag or blocking text obscures play. Pause at8 if required until it clears; do not accumulate delayed hazard backlog.
timeline.completion: Alive at35 unlocks guaranteed harmless drain and landing; at45 latch flush_survived once. Landing exchange runs in safe terminal hold. Completion/next prototype boundary follows dialogue or skip. No enemies must be killed.

movement.steering: Existing keyboard/controller directional actions steer XY in unprojected world plane. Normalize diagonals; screen up maps negative worldY. Keep fixed camera and character facing from last horizontal steering.
movement.current: Clockwise tangential plus mild inward drift, summed as one vector capped by mode. No screen rotation. Reduce to35% during calm stage, ramp toward full cap during survival. Clamp annulus gently without edge damage or instant death.
movement.reason: Slowest hero235 minus hardest opposing current80 leaves155worldpixels/second. Match Level Design path validation; never exceed current caps or assume projected screen distance is world distance.

jump.height_axis: Independent positive Z; no change to XY steering/current while airborne
jump.input: Existing jump press/buffer; no double jump
jump.collision: Low debris does not hit when Z>24; jumping does not ignore any future explicitly airborne volume.

weapons.preserve: Selected hero, current active weapon identity, projectile speed, cadence, damage and range. Do not use older canonical weapon damage in place of active level tuning.
weapons.aim: Use existing separate aim inputs if available; otherwise last nonzero normalized eight-way steering is persistent world-plane aim. Render transformed muzzle/direction consistently; do not alter range by screen projection.

soft_debris.target_window: When incoming soft debris is physically visible during its warning/fall and while active; never require firing at an invisible marker. Destroy once, immediately remove collision, consume normal projectile, no required kills.

weapons.hard_debris: Porcelain is dodge/jump-only. Ordinary shots stop at the visible hard obstacle; no damage to it.

hazards.placement: Warning and landing use the same locked world center. No tracking after tell starts. No persistent puddles.
hazards.safety: Before warning and before activation, prove an annulus-valid reachable safe pocket with48px clearance budget, using combined36px hero/debris footprint and155px/s net movement after0.15s reaction margin. Test all overlapping pending/active hazards, current direction and boundaries. Defer within stage or skip an unsafe event; never dump backlog, trap the hero, or delay completion.
hazards.rng: Retain attempt seed across retries for learnable patterns; no undocumented difficulty scaling.
hazards.damage: One health per accepted contact through shared normal1.5s invulnerability. Two Hard overlaps cannot bypass cooldown. No added control interruption or instant kills.

health_lives_retry.entry: Carry selected hero, difficulty, remaining health and lives from Level1. No free entry heal or life award. Remove all Level1 hazards/projectiles/boss audio before transfer.
health_lives_retry.anchor: Flush start is the new attempt anchor; death never sends the hero back to Clogfather.
health_lives_retry.death: Use normal death/popup flow and exactly one existing life debit; freeze flush timer and hazards.
health_lives_retry.continue: Reset complete flush attempt: timer0, seed retained, all hazards/shots/current transient state cleared, spawn restored, full hero health and normal3s invulnerability. Preserve remaining lives.
health_lives_retry.retry_intro: Skip repeated arrival/gag dialogue but retain the entire0..8 calm movement warmup. Do not jump clock directly to8.
health_lives_retry.game_over_retry: Restart this flush attempt with standard new-run3lives/fullhealth and same chosen hero/difficulty; explicit New Game/menu can restart campaign normally.
health_lives_retry.checkpoint: No mid-flush dispenser or clone consumption. No additional43s checkpoint required because35..45 is already harmless. Survived/completed flag is single-fire at45; boundary after landing dialogue/skip.

integration_checks: Both heroes and all3 difficulties; normalized diagonal speed, projection and jump/HUD clearance
45-second stage boundaries at60/120Hz; pause/blocking overlay/death freeze and dismissal input guard
Guaranteed safe pocket at inner/outer annulus and every hazard placement, including Hard overlap and current opposition
Two actual weapon hits destroy visible soft debris; hard debris remains; jump clears low debris; no invisible lingering hurt after destruction
Entry carries health/lives; death debits once; repeated retry resets entire attempt and preserves seed; GameOver retry stays in flush
At35 all harm clears; no mandatory kills; safe drain/landing reaches single completion at45 and no full ride starts
remaining: Engineering runtime and packaged checks, Art-authored visuals, Audio-assigned cues with registry/audition updates, Storyboarding final dialogue; human steering/aim/readability/balance review and actual captures.
